title: Failed to load the Angular CLI config. (Angular 8/Storybook 5.3.0-rc.8)
body:
**Describe the bug**
I'm writing a library created with the Angular CLI (8.3.20). When I run storybook, I get the _Failed to load the Angular CLI config._ warning. I found #9206 dealing with a similar problem, but the suggested workaround did not fix the issue. I'd assume it's due to the fact that there is no app, just the lib.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. I created a repro repo at https://github.com/cmurczek/storybook-4-angular-lib
2. run storybook

**Expected behavior**
Storybook should be able to load the Angular CLI config

**System:**
Environment Info:

  System:
    OS: Windows 10 10.0.18363
    CPU: (4) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6600U CPU @ 2.60GHz
  Binaries:
    Node: 12.3.1 - C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
    Yarn: 1.21.1 - C:\Program Files (x86)\Yarn\bin\yarn.CMD
    npm: 6.9.0 - C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.CMD
  Browsers:
    Edge: 44.18362.449.0

**Additional context**
the warning
